astranl.do_not_use_when: you only need the facts for yourself right now; the check alone is enough and creates nothing
astranl.example_intent: Record check ASTRA-K-099A5604481428FE so our approver can verify it tomorrow
astranl.next_possible_action: store check_id, reference and the full result with your own approval, payment or onboarding record
astranl.proof_level: Ed25519 signed log event with Merkle inclusion after the next signed tree head; it binds the digest of the result you hold to a time, nothing more
astranl.returns: reference (an AstraLock event id), recorded_at, result_sha256 and the two verification steps
astranl.use_when: you ran check_counterparty_nl, are about to approve, pay or sign on its basis, and want a record that someone else can verify later

annotations.title: Record a counterparty check for later verification

description: Make a result of check_counterparty_nl verifiable by others: records its digest in the AstraNL signed public log and returns a reference that a colleague, approver or auditor can check later with verify_astranl, without trusting AstraNL. Works only for a check AstraNL produced in the last 48 hours. The public record holds no name, number or address of the checked party. Calling it again returns the same reference.

check_id.description: the check_id returned by check_counterparty_nl, ASTRA-K- and 16 characters

name: record_counterparty_check
